titulo_es: Use «se» in questions of yes or no

texto: **Verbo de pregunta o duda**: chiedere, domandare, voler sapere, non sapere.
**Nexo «se»**: introduces the alternative: **Mi ha chiesto se avevo fame** / **Mi ha chiesto se avessi fame** (asked me if I was hungry).
The congiuntive imperfect (**avessi, fossi, potessi**) confers greater literary elegance on the phrase.

filas: Mi ha chiesto se ero stanco.
Mi ha chiesto se fossi stanco.

frases.it: Mi scusi, vorrei sapere se fosse disponibile per due domande sul quartiere.
frases.es: Disculpe, quisiera saber si estaría disponible para dos preguntas sobre el barrio.
frases.en: Excuse me, I'd like to know if you'd be available for two questions about the neighborhood.
analisis: I'd like to know if he'd be available.
for two questions about the neighborhood

frases.it: Certamente, dica pure! Che cosa le interessa?
frases.en: Of course, say it! What do you care?

frases.it: Volevo sapere se i trasporti pubblici funzionassero bene a quest'ora.
frases.es: Quería saber si los transportes públicos funcionaban bien a esta hora.
frases.en: He wanted to know if public transport was working well at this time.

frases.it: La metropolitana funziona benissimo, ma mancano autobus notturni dopo mezzanotte.
frases.es: El metro funciona muy bien, pero faltan autobuses nocturnos después de medianoche.
frases.en: The subway works very well, but there are no night buses after midnight.

bloques.pregunta: What link does the indirect question enter in «vorrei sapere se fosse disponibile»?

opciones.explicacion: It links the total indirect question of yes or no.
The prepositions do not introduce complete interrogation clauses.
«Che» would introduce a complete declarative, not a doubt of itself or not.

bloques.frase: Il giornalista voleva sapere se i residenti ___ soddisfatti dei servizi comunali.

opciones.explicacion: Third person of plural of the «essere» imfetus congiuntive.
It is imperfect of indicative (common in informal but less elegant record).

bloques.pregunta: What is the tone of the «funzionassero» congiuntive?
bloques.frase: Voleva sapere se i trasporti pubblici funzionassero bene.

opciones.texto: A formal and refined tone of the journalistic or administrative record.
opciones.explicacion: The imfet congiuntive increases the stylistic correction of the indirect question.

opciones.texto: A cover-up insult against the transport company.
opciones.explicacion: It does not hold a pejorative trial but a formal consultation.

opciones.texto: The absolute certainty that no bus is running around the city.
opciones.explicacion: He asked about the quality of the service without taking the answer for granted.

bloques.frase: Volevo sapere se fosse possibile parlare con il responsabile dell'ufficio
bloques.traduccion: I wanted to know if it was possible to talk to the office manager.
bloques.explicacion: Indirect formal question with congiuntive imperfect after «se».

bloques.pregunta: How does a direct question differ from an Italian indirect?

opciones.texto: The direct one carries signs of questioning and inverted order; the indirect is subordinated with nexus and without signs.
La directa es siempre incorrecta gramaticalmente.
opciones.explicacion: Both are perfectly legitimate and common.

opciones.texto: The indirect can only be used in writing in newspapers.
opciones.explicacion: It is used with total naturality in the daily oral language.

bloques.frase: Il turista mi ha domandato dove ___ prendere l'autobus per il centro.

opciones.explicacion: Congiuntive imfect singular of the modal verb «potere» after questioning «dove».

bloques.pregunta: What structure does this prayer present?
bloques.frase: Mi ha chiesto se avevo fame o se preferivo riposare.

opciones.texto: Una doble alternativa indirecta coordinada mediante la conjunción disyuntiva «o se».
opciones.explicacion: Excellent question model with two parallel options.

opciones.texto: A clear order that requires immediate food.
opciones.explicacion: It gives you a friendly choice between eating or resting.

opciones.texto: A reproach for being late for lunch.
opciones.explicacion: Don't reproach anything, just ask for your physical needs.

intro: In the total indirect questions (those that expect a yes or no for answer), the indispensable link is «se». The subordinate does not have any interrogative signs and may be indicative or congiuntive.
